interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Removing parking spaces near potential crossing points to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Designated Trash Zones
interventions.description: Establish designated areas for trash collection that do not impede the pedestrian clear zone on the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the asphalt to eliminate cracks and improve the overall safety of the travel way.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Infill
interventions.description: Repair the uneven sections of the sidewalk to provide a continuous, ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Install speed cushions to maintain low vehicle speeds on this residential street.

interventions.title: Dedicated Amenity Zone
interventions.description: Designate specific areas for trash collection and utilities outside of the clear walking path to maintain sidewalk accessibility.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Resurface the roadway to eliminate cracks and provide a smooth, predictable surface for all users.

interventions.title: Waste Management Enforcement
interventions.description: Implement designated areas or better management for trash collection to keep the sidewalk clear of obstructions.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the roadway to eliminate cracks and uneven surfaces.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant paved sidewalk to separate pedestrians from vehicular traffic.

interventions.title: Designated Trash Collection Areas
interventions.description: Implement a management plan for waste bins to ensure they do not obstruct the pedestrian right-of-way.
